1.mascotDialogue: Extract-max is really two moves — swap the root with the last leaf, shrink the heap by one, then let that displaced value sink to wherever it actually belongs.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 4 and 5 find the biggest of the node and its two kids. Line 8's recursive call, that's what lets the displaced value keep sinking past more than one level, if it's gotta.

3.mascotDialogue: 9 sits on top, and every parent beats both its children, all the way down. Same array-index math as min heap — just the comparison flipped, güey.

4.mascotDialogue: The swap alone doesn't finish the job! Without siftDown, you just relocated the problem to the top of the tree — didn't solve nada.
